title: Zelenskyy delivers address at United Nations General Assembly
summary: Zelenskyy tells the UN General Assembly that weak institutions and Russia's war have set off a drone and AI arms race, and calls for global rules on AI in weapons.

assertions.quote: even during bloodshed, there isn't a signal. international institution that can truly stop it.
Estonia had to call a UN Security Council meeting for the first time in history because Russian fighter jets deliberately entered its airspace.
cheap drones could create dead zones, areas stretching for dozens of kilometers where nothing moves
it's only a matter of time, not much before drones are fighting drones, attacking critical infrastructure and targeting people all by themselves.

verdicts.note: Autonomy is spreading fast in Ukraine, but most strike drones still need a human to pick the target and full autonomy at scale is not imminent.

assertions.quote: we are now living through the most destructive arms race in human history because this time includes it includes artificial intelligence.

verdicts.note: The Cold War nuclear build-up to tens of thousands of warheads remains far more destructive than any AI arms race so far.

assertions.quote: Ukraine doesn't have the big fat missiles dictators love to show off in parades.
Yet there is no ceasefire because Russia refuses.
